_comment: Licence policy of the Sovereign Agentic OS - the ONE file scripts/license-gate.mjs reads.
Owner decision 2026-11-22; it replaces the old 'Apache/MIT/BSD/ISC only' rule and applies to the WHOLE repo:
OS code, images, chart components and app templates (npm, Python, container/Go components).
allow  - SPDX ids that may be bundled. Compared case-insensitively and exactly.
forbid - glob patterns ('*' = anything). Forbidden always fails and can NOT be waived by licenses/exceptions.json.
Anything neither allowed nor forbidden is UNKNOWN and fails unless licenses/exceptions.json carries a reviewed reason.
Dual-licensed (SPDX 'A OR B', or legacy 'A/B'): passes if ANY option is allowed, and the chosen option is recorded.
'A AND B' needs every side allowed. 'WITH <exception>' does not change the base licence.
attributionExempt - every OTHER chosen licence needs an attribution entry (the package name) in one of noticesFiles.
aliases - legacy/free-text licence strings (npm, PyPI) mapped to an SPDX id. An ambiguous string (for example a bare 'BSD') is deliberately NOT mapped: it stays unknown.
